name: Samurai Warlord Supreme
purpose: Display on Warlord rank progression and heavy weapon upgrades.
visual: Demonic horned kabuto warlord holding two-handed nodachi greatsword.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. An imposing supreme samurai warlord in horned demonic kabuto armor and spiked shoulder plates, holding a colossal two-handed nodachi sword planted into the ground. Giant solid crimson sun backdrop, pitch black canvas, sharp vector edges, no anime, no 3D, no text.
